questions.question: Which description fits the **StructureDefinition** resource?
options: A definition of a FHIR structure.
A search parameter that defines a named search item that can be used to search/filter on a resource.
A Map of relationships between 2 structures that can be used to transform data.

This resource documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Server for a particular version of FHIR that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server…
questions.explanation: **StructureDefinition**: A definition of a FHIR structure. This resource is used to describe the underlying resources, data types defined in FHIR, and also for describing extensions and constraints on resources and data types. The other descriptions belong to **SearchParameter**, **StructureMap**, **CapabilityStatement**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? A profile that requires Observation.category to be vital-signs for blood pressure readings.
questions.explanation: **StructureDefinition**. Profiles, extensions, resources and data types are all StructureDefinitions.

questions.question: You know **StructureDefinition**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “the package that holds the profiles”?
questions.explanation: **ImplementationGuide**: the package that holds the profiles. **StructureDefinition** is for something else: A definition of a FHIR structure.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **StructureDefinition** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of StructureDefinition are `url` (1..1), `name` (1..1), `status` (1..1), `kind` (1..1), `abstract` (1..1), `type` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **StructureDefinition** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of StructureDefinition: `status`. `status`: draft | active | retired | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
